name: furnishing
description: Player furniture in rooms they control. `place <item>` sets a carried furniture item down as a piece in your flat, your corp's HQ or your own storefront; `take <piece>` picks your own piece back up as an item, if you can carry it; and when a property is released (moved out, evicted, repossessed, HQ torn down) every piece a player placed there goes back to that player's inventory, container contents included. Placed rows are `origin='player'` with a `furn_<8hex>` id, so the content export and import never touch them. The buy-side carry choice lives in the engine's furniture-shop.js.
